description: This file defines UI theme elements and style components for a SwiftUI application, including color tokens, view modifiers, button styles, and reusable view components to match Android design references.

classes.name: AndroidRefCard
classes.description: A reusable card container with padding, background, border, and rounded corners.

classes.name: AndroidRefTextFieldStyle
classes.description: A custom TextFieldStyle for styled text fields consistent with Android reference UI.

classes.name: AndroidRefPrimaryButtonStyle
classes.description: A ButtonStyle for a primary blue button with specific height, corner radius, and disabled state styling.

classes.name: AndroidRefChipButtonStyle
classes.description: A ButtonStyle for small chip buttons with fill and border, used in session action rows.
